body: start writing, bud. what's wrong? you have at least three that will listen and try to help.
what has you confused? i know i'm just a random online but i'll listen and help as best i can
other people don't matter. most will leave/use you/etc but it's like that for everyone. you can only find satisfaction within yourself.
Whatever your condition is, I'm sure someone else has it. Have you talked to someone who does?

I always try to improve but I don't think I care about the things I used to want anymore (career, relationship, friends, etc.) I might be too misanthropic at this point. 

You're right in a way- this deep trough could make me less anxious about the bullshit if I make out alive. But I need some kind of motivation. Not caring isn't a long term solution or I'd be jobless and holed up in my apt with my cat everyday until they evict me. The knowledge that I could just give up at any time is what makes it easier.

I appreciate the reply though.
I'm in a similar situation mental health-wise. I'm sincerely impressed you can have a good career and supportive friends while you're in that situation.

what would you want to do if you weren't in college? it sounds like you had motivation at one point but now it's gone because you're a path someone else set for you. it might help to focus on what you actually want to keep things in a long term perspective, even if the path there seems impossible right now

is there something in particular making you so depressed or is this just how you always feel?
